guide.summary: A metabolite eater that spends energy making an enzyme that turns oil into metabolite.
guide.biology: Some microbes release enzymes outside their bodies that break down fats and oils into smaller pieces they can absorb.
guide.rules: Eats metabolite only; cannot eat oil directly. When oil is in or beside its cell and it has more than 35 energy, it releases lipid enzyme at 0.40 energy per second. The metabolite that enzyme makes is free for anyone nearby to eat. Moves 0.25 cells per second and senses food, and oil it could convert, up to 2 cells away.
guide.example: Put Oilwicks on an oil patch with Crossfeeders and see whether the Crossfeeders grow too.
